definition: H(n)=0 at A=7, frozen definitions: n prime, n = 1 (mod 24); B_7(n)=int((ln n)^7); for each prime p = 3 (mod 4) with p <= B_7(n) and n a quadratic non-residue mod p, K=(n+p)/4, qs = distinct prime factors of K, k=len(qs), c_g = subset-product counts of qs mod p, N_{-1} = sum_g c_g*c_{-g mod p}, margin(n,p) = (p-1)*N_{-1}/4^k. H(n) = max margin over those p. Certified H=0 means margin exactly 0 at every such p, i.e. margin_positive_count = 0 over the full range, with the stated NR count. G(n) = min over those p of the budget gap PhiS - 2m, PhiS = (p-1)*R/4^k, R = sum_g c_g^2, m = (p-1)/lcm_i ord_p(q_i). C(n) = nr_count.

primes.basis: Two full-range scans in the source data (a full evaluation scan and an independent margin-only scan) agree on the NR count and on no positive margin; the full evaluation scan also gives the minimum budget gap and its argmin configuration.
